faq.question: Is my JSON data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. All conversion happens in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faq.question: How are JSON arrays handled in XML?
faq.answer: JSON arrays are converted to repeated XML elements with the same tag name.

faq.question: Can I convert XML back to JSON?
faq.answer: Yes. Use our XML to JSON converter to convert XML back to JSON format.

faq.question: Does it support nested JSON objects?
faq.answer: Yes. Nested objects become nested XML elements, preserving the structure.

faq.question: Can I convert large JSON files?
faq.answer: Yes. This json to xml converter handles files of any size. Since all processing happens locally, file size is limited only by your browser's memory.

faq.question: How do I convert JSON to XML?
faq.answer: Simply paste your JSON data and click Convert. This free online tool lets you convert json to xml instantly — no upload required.

faq.question: 我的 JSON 数据会上传到服务器吗？
faq.answer: 不会。所有转换在浏览器中完成，数据不会离开你的设备。

faq.question: JSON 数组在 XML 中怎么处理？
faq.answer: JSON 数组转换为具有相同标签名的重复 XML 元素。

faq.question: 可以把 XML 转回 JSON 吗？
faq.answer: 可以。使用我们的 XML 转 JSON 转换器将 XML 转回 JSON 格式。

faq.question: 支持嵌套 JSON 对象吗？
faq.answer: 支持。嵌套对象变成嵌套的 XML 元素，保留结构。

faq.question: 可以转换大型 JSON 文件吗？
faq.answer: 可以。所有处理在本地完成，文件大小仅受浏览器内存限制。
